data.description: The Chest Press Double has two seats facing pressing handles, so two people can do the same upper-body exercise side by side. Seated users push the handles forward and let them return, working the chest, shoulders and arms against their own body weight. A double unit is useful where the gym gets busy at fixed times, such as before office hours in a corporate campus or after school in a society. It comes in Play Orange, with orange seats, as part of our Fun Fitness range. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include the Chest Press Double on your layout drawing.

items.pText: The Chest Press Double has two seats facing pressing handles, so two people can do the same upper-body exercise side by side. Seated users push the handles forward and let them return, working the chest, shoulders and arms against their own body weight. A double unit is useful where the gym gets busy at fixed times, such as before office hours in a corporate campus or after school in a society. It comes in Play Orange, with orange seats, as part of our Fun Fitness range. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include the Chest Press Double on your layout drawing.

The pressing arms swing on pivots, so check bearings and seat fixings during routine maintenance. We install the double press self-standing or grouted. Leave clear space in front of both handle sets, and place it where users can see each other, which helps when two people are training together.
